transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve just been feeling really worn out most days. Even when I sleep through the night, I wake up feeling like my body and my head are still dragging… especially before my cashier shift.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About… a year and three months, I guess. It started around when an older relative moved in with us.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before you started feeling this way?
I… I’m not really sure. I still do some of the same things, I guess. I haven’t thought about whether I enjoy them less or not.
Do you feel like you get as much pleasure from activities as you used to?
I don’t really know. I mean… I still do things, but I haven’t paid much attention to whether they feel as good as before.
Do you feel like things that used to make you happy no longer do?
I’m not sure… I haven’t really noticed it that way. Some things still seem okay, I guess.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… I haven’t really thought of it as losing interest. I still do some stuff, I guess.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that normally would make you happy?
I don’t know if I’d say unable. I haven’t really noticed it that clearly… some things still feel okay, I guess.
Do you feel like you're having less fun or getting less pleasure out of things compared to before you started feeling worn out?
Maybe a little, but I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying that much attention to it… I still get some enjoyment from things, I think.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I’m not sure… I wouldn’t say most of the time. I have down moments, but I don’t really think of myself as sad all day or anything.
Do you feel sad more often than not?
Not really… I mean, I get sad sometimes, but I don’t think it’s more often than not. Hard to say exactly.
Do you feel sad every day?
I don’t think it’s every day… I haven’t really kept track, but no, not every day.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight since you started feeling worn out?
Not really… I haven’t noticed my weight changing much. I don’t check it that often, though.
Do you feel sad for most of the day?
No… I don’t think it’s most of the day. It kind of comes and goes, I guess.
Do you think you've been feeling down or depressed for at least two years?
I’m not really sure… two years sounds like a long time. I don’t think I’ve been down like that the whole time, no.
Have you been feeling this way for more than two years?
No… not more than two years. It’s been more like, I guess, about a year and a few months—since an older relative moved in with us.
Have you lost or gained a significant amount of weight since you started feeling worn out?
I don’t think so… I haven’t really noticed any big change either way.
Do you feel like you've been depressed for most of the days since your relative moved in?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say depressed most days. Maybe worn down sometimes, but not really depressed all the time.
Do you feel like you're unable to enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable?
I’m not sure… I still enjoy some things, I guess. Maybe not as much when I’m tired, but I wouldn’t say I can’t enjoy them.
Have you had periods of feeling down or depressed that lasted for two weeks or more at a time?
Not really, no… I’ve felt down here and there, but I don’t think it’s been like two weeks straight.
Have you had a period of two weeks or more where you felt depressed or down nearly every day?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had rough days, but not like two weeks nearly every day.
